name: Advanced Baseline Imager Level 2 - Land Surface Bidirectional Reflectance Factor
description: Estimates land surface bidirectional reflectance factors at ABI bands 1, 2, 3, 5, and 6, correcting for atmospheric effects and viewing geometry. The product supports vegetation monitoring, surface energy balance studies, and land cover classification.
